scope: Exact user-reported hesitant text after the generated opening and visible bar-name question. Actual signed Worker RPC, real JEV/dialogue, authoritative physical positions and idle observations. Collision checks use current local authored geometry. No human microphone, hardware audio, keys or capabilities recorded.
opening: Hola, buenas, tengo tu paquete y estoy cerca de un bar. ¿Por dónde voy?

finalHistory.text: The resident answered the incoming delivery call. The 60-second delivery window began.
Hola, buenas, tengo tu paquete y estoy cerca de un bar. ¿Por dónde voy?
Ah, ¿cómo se llama el bar?
The courier read the currently visible sign: Bar Llevant.
Estoy junto a Bar Llevant. ¿En qué lado está tu portal?
Tal esta en la de sur.
Courier started: Walk one visible leg toward the reported south entrance. Arrival and handoff have not yet happened.
Avanzo hacia el sur hasta donde alcanzo a ver y me detengo.
At the visible-leg stop the courier looked south while standing still, to inspect the next visible direction. No new movement was started.

The courier stopped at the end of the current visible movement leg. The intended destination remains remembered, but has not been reached. The courier awaits a new resident command and does not start another leg automatically.
Ahora veo el cruce de calles del suroeste al sur. ¿Sigo desde aquí?
Ah, sigue, hasta la próxima vez que venga.
Courier started: Walk one visible leg toward the reported south entrance. Arrival and handoff have not yet happened.
Avanzo solo hasta donde alcanza mi vista y me detengo. Veo el cruce de calles del suroeste.
At the visible-leg stop the courier looked east while standing still, to inspect the next visible direction. No new movement was started.

The courier stopped at the end of the current visible movement leg. The intended destination remains remembered, but has not been reached. The courier awaits a new resident command and does not start another leg automatically.
Ahora veo la entrada sur del bloque al este. ¿Me acerco?
Ah, sigue por la-- sigue, sigue en este tramo.
Courier started: Walk one visible leg toward the reported south entrance. Arrival and handoff have not yet happened.
The courier arrived at the entrance described by the resident. The parcel remains with the courier until a physical handoff.
Llego hasta la entrada sur del bloque. Vale, voy hacia tu portal en el lado sur.
Ya he llegado a tu portal. ¿Puedes bajar a por el paquete?
Ah, sigue hasta la próxima esquina.
Vale, me quedo aquí en tu portal esperando a que bajes.
